title: "match anywhere" in Dag search UI should be persisted as URL param
body: ### Description We have the ability to search for Dags by display-name/ ID. By default, the search looks at the start of the Dag_id, and we have the option to turn on "match anywhere", to search for a pattern anywhere in the name of the Dag. However, this property is not persisted as a URL param. Therefor, when you share the filtered search results with a colleague, they do not see the same search results you see. Adding a new `match-anywhere=true` URL param, when that feature is toggled on, would allow there shared search results to correctly take this capability into account. ### Use case/motivation This feature will allow a user to share the filtered Dag list they see when filtering the Dags and using match-anywhere, with anyone else, since this parameter would be persisted in the URL. ### Related issues _No response_ ### Are you willing to submit a PR? - [x] Yes I am willing to submit a PR! ### Code of Conduct - [x] I agree to follow this project's [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
